measurement_note: Size S is the total number of input characters. Legal tiers 512, 2048, and 8192 span 16x and use alternating two-character words; each internal removal creates a length-two bridge while unchanged adjacencies have length one. The accepted prefix/suffix method performs Theta(S) work. A correct calibrated alternative precomputes adjacent scores but copies the surviving score slices and scans their maximum for every removal, taking Theta(S^2) on this fixed-length family; it must pass every output and fail only the scaling verdict.
